name: VUSE XR
summary:
VUSE XR brings your products to life in mixed reality.
View immersive 3D experiences on your Meta Quest: from hands-on training to detailed product showcases. Follow clear, step-by-step guides that show you how to operate, service, and maintain complex devices, with animations, explosion views, and interactions that make every step easy to understand.

This app is built for viewing experiences created on the VUSE XR Hub. Open an experience shared with you and explore it in XR, at your own pace.
